name: Physically-Based Rendering (PBR) Lighting
definition: Calculates lighting contributions using a physically-based shading model with diffuse (Burley) and specular (microfacet) components, driven by metallic-roughness inputs.
summary: Physically-Based Rendering Lighting calculates direct lighting using a metallic-roughness model that replaces standard terms with Burley diffuse and microfacet specular components for energy-conserving, view-dependent shading.
